description: Result interpretation (design §8.2): the exit code and termination signal are AUTHORITATIVE for fail/not-fail; the envelope may only refine WITHIN the not-failed class, never override to delivered. Data-only in Milestone A (Task A3) — consumed by the real interpretResult() a launcher's result.ts implements in Milestone B (Task B3).

expected.note: the exit record cannot be overridden to delivered by a printed envelope, even a success envelope
the envelope is preferred evidence for the outcome shade, never required, never authoritative over the exit record
death by signal is failed regardless of envelope — a harness that segfaults after printing success is failed, not delivered
presence of outputs is never the verdict (§7.4) — an honest empty result and a lying one are distinguished by the exit record, not output count
